title: Historical commercial AIS effort · July and September 2024
attribution: © Global Fishing Watch. 2025. Global AIS-based Apparent Fishing Effort Dataset v3.0. Extracted and aggregated by SkipperCast.
changes: Regional subset; repeated-date selection; harbor/MPA exclusion; adjacent equal-gear cells unioned without bridging gaps.

selection.method_note: Thresholds are a display filter to emphasize repeated activity; they are not a validated hotspot classifier.

mpa_screen.action: withhold entire cell on any intersection
mpa_screen.source_freshness_note: Use app’s current CDFW exclusion layer again at load time.

limits: Historical AIS-based modeled apparent fishing, not current boats or verified catches.
2024 classifications are provisional in this dataset.
Gear classification can be wrong for multi-gear vessels and slow transit can create false positives.
Sparse AIS reception and vessels without AIS mean absence of data is not absence of fishing.
The source is predominantly commercial fishing; it does not establish local recreational charter identity.
Fishing gear is not a target-species identification; no crab, rockfish, lingcod or tuna attribution is made.
No depth or navigation qualification. Offshore cells must not become under-200-foot fish targets.
Daily vessel counts cannot be summed to produce unique boats.
